training: 120 months preceding 12 calendar months of calibration; actual label maturity purged at each boundary. Identical annual clock across model types.
models: tabm pooled FULL33 seed2 per-corridor calibration
tabm KZT FULL33 seed2 local calibration
strict_control: v3 original pooled Platt probability >=0.5, cooldown3, maximum2 per corridor-week; preserve historical parity
static_cadence: Same existing quantile grid q=0,.05,..,.80, fixed prior-year probability threshold, cooldown2; maximize calibration lift subject to chosen coverage; fallback clearly labelled.
rolling_rank: Prior 63 same-corridor scores only, empirical percentile including ties at midpoint, no current/future score in reference window. Fixed q from grid0..0.80 step0.05 chosen using prior-year calibration only; max2/calendarweek cooldown2, no quota filling. Last20+ past scores required; 63 panel dates before calibration (including purged training tail), scored by the frozen checkpoint with all outcomes masked, warm validation; complete prior calibration history warms test.
rank_shared: One dimensionless rank cutoff across all corridors, chosen in calibration to satisfy minimum corridor coverage, else maximum minimum coverage; tests transfer of the same parameter across corridors.
metrics: Hit rate, year/corridor standardized lift/forward delta, regret, Brier/logloss/AUC, signals, observed calendar week counts with silent/partial weeks, per-year/corridor minima. Full naturally mature test cohort per horizon; cross-horizon rescore on common H5-matured cohort separately.
selection: Frozen lexicographic rule on 2024-2025 first, then audit frozen winner in 2026. Hard gates in every evaluated year/corridor: coverage>=0.80, lift>=1.30, forward_delta_bps>0; prefer coverage>=0.90 everywhere. If infeasible explicitly say no qualifying model. Among qualified maximize worst-cell lift then worst-cell utility then lower mean Brier. For an operational fallback minimize total normalized gate shortfall then maximize worst-cell lift; never call fallback qualified. Additionally report retrospective all-three-year ranking separately.
scope: Separate all5 universal and KZT rankings; KZT-only model cannot claim all5 performance.
inference: Retrospective periods already examined in prior research. No untouched holdout claim or universal architecture superiority. Block CIs conditional on fixed scores/policies.
reporting: Single union CSV with source_report/protocol/row_type identifiers; prior architecture and reconciliation reports plus new metrics and CI rows, no silent mixing of scopes or horizons. Final recommendation and manifest saved in new isolated research folder; previous checkpoints remain untouched.
